ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure shows a six-membered-ring transition-state structure, and the curved arrows inside the ring need to be ignored. The carbon at the top of the ring is connected simultaneously to a fluorine atom and an amino group, and the other end of the amino group is R, which can be represented with the wildcard * as *N. The right-side ortho position on the ring is connected to NO2, and the bottom is also connected to NO2; a negative charge is also marked inside the ring, corresponding to a ring carbon that needs to be explicitly written as [C-]. Then reason: according to the specified method, starting from the R wildcard connected to the amine is written as *N; after the amine is connected to the fluorine-substituted ring starting carbon, *NC1(F) is obtained. Write along the six-membered ring according to the alternating double bonds in the figure, encode the two nitro groups as [N+](=O)[O-], write the negatively charged ring carbon as [C-], and finally close the ring to 1. Thus the SMILES is obtained: *NC1(F)C=CC([N+](=O)[O-])=C[C-]1[N+](=O)[O-].

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: First transcribe only the molecular skeleton from the image, disregarding the reaction arrows. Start the SMILES at the R group as wildcard attached to amine: *N. Connect N to the substituted ring carbon and mark the six-membered ring start as C1, adding the fluorine branch: *NC1(F). Traverse the ring around the drawn bonds, placing the ortho nitro branch on the appropriate ring carbon, the para nitro branch on the lower ring carbon, and the explicit anionic carbon as [C-] before closing back to atom 1. Encode each nitro group as [N+](=O)[O-] and retain the alternating double bonds shown in the ring. This yields *NC1(F)C=CC([N+](=O)[O-])=C[C-]1[N+](=O)[O-].
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中是一个六元环过渡态结构，需忽略环内的弯箭头。环顶端碳同时连有氟原子和一个胺基，胺基另一端为 R，可用通配符 * 表示为 *N。环上右侧邻位连有 NO2，底部也连有 NO2；环内还标出一个负电荷，对应需要显式写成 [C-] 的环碳。再推理：按指定方法从 R 通配符连到胺开始写作 *N，胺连到带氟取代的环起始碳，得到 *NC1(F)。沿六元环按图中交替双键书写，并把两个硝基编码为 [N+](=O)[O-]，将带负电荷的环碳写为 [C-]，最后闭环到 1。由此得到 SMILES：*NC1(F)C=CC([N+](=O)[O-])=C[C-]1[N+](=O)[O-]。

It does not rely on recognizing the reaction class beyond standard SMILES syntax.
planner_metadata.image_role: Use the image to read a six-membered ring transition-state structure while ignoring curved arrows. The top ring carbon is bonded to F and to an HN-R substituent; the ring has nitro groups on the right and bottom carbons; one ring carbon is explicitly negatively charged; the drawn double bonds determine the C=C positions.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question text only to know the requested output is a SMILES expression and that the arrows in the transition-state drawing should be ignored.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Apply SMILES conventions: represent the unspecified R group as wildcard '*', nitro as [N+](=O)[O-], charged ring carbon as [C-], branches in parentheses, and use ring-closure digit 1 while preserving the drawn single/double bond pattern.
